scope: Independent numeric acceptance audit. Logic simulation only (Icarus Verilog 14 + Python exact arithmetic + C libc cross-check). No synthesis, no Vivado, no board, no VNC, no push. No module under test was modified.
verdict: NOT ACCEPTED. i48->f32 and f32->i16 pass the independent vectors; the repaired FMA still fails RNE tie-to-even and extreme exponent alignment; the repaired approx core still has factor-2 boundary errors and an RSQRT(-0) sign error; the epilogue stream engine corrupts A16 tags, duplicates A16 handshakes under 128-bit backpressure, ignores the parameter preload port, and allows a configuration change to hit an in-flight beat.

reference_independence.method: Python Fractions/integers implement RNE from first principles; no gemini golden model is imported.
reference_independence.note: C fmaf/lrintf/cast are an independent implementation. The FMA crosscheck is restricted to normal-input finite non-zero results because the DUT and the contract differ on FTZ/special signed-zero conventions.

observed.model_family: Conformer/Transformer ASR encoder-decoder (ONNX names: encoder.encoders.N, decoder.decoders.N, conv_module, norm_mha/norm_conv/norm_ff/norm_ff_macaron)

verdict.model_family: REFUTED: the project image is a Conformer/Transformer ASR, not KWT-1
verdict.layernorm_var_range: UNVERIFIED for this model: no ONNX/calibration data in the read-only tree; the [1e-6,1e2] range is a KWT/old-competition assumption
verdict.epsilon: UNVERIFIED for this model: epsilon is not present in the parameter image
verdict.softmax_row_length: REFUTED as a model-wide claim: 24 Softmax ops over time-frame axes; case0000 has 128 frames/16 supplied tokens, not 99 keywords

blocking_findings.summary: RNE tie-to-even is still wrong for exact halfway products. Example 0x3f800003 * 0x3fc00000: correct 0x3fc00004, DUT 0x3fc00005. 90/8311 normal-input vectors mismatch (66 normal/normal/normal + 24 normal/normal/zero).
Extreme exponent alignment is broken. Example 0x00800000 * 0x3f800001 + 0x3f800000 should be 0x3f800000 (1.0) but returns 0x0e800000 (2^-97).
blocking_findings.evidence: result_fma_repair.json by_class normal; C fmaf crosscheck

blocking_findings.summary: Special values: inf*0 returns inf instead of NaN; inf + (-inf) returns inf instead of NaN; signed-zero cases are inverted. 34 inf-class and 2 zero-class mismatches.
DIV factor-2 boundary error: 1.0 / 31.9998 (0x3f800000/0x41fffad2) returns 0x3d7fde3c (0.06247) instead of 0.03125 (99.88% relative error). This is outside the claimed 0.108% bound.
RSQRT factor-2 boundary error at max finite: RSQRT(0x7f7fffff) returns 0x1ffffff4 (1.084e-19) instead of 5.421e-20 (99.99985% relative error).
RSQRT(-0) and RSQRT(negative subnormal) return +inf; IEEE-754 sign is -inf. flags[1] is set, but the sign is wrong. Low model impact (LayerNorm var+eps > 0).
A16 tag is corrupted whenever the 128-bit packer holds a pending beat: a16_tag is muxed from p128_tag. 255/256 A16 tags wrong at BP0; example beat 2 gets tag 1 instead of 2.

A16 ready/valid violation under 128-bit packed backpressure: a16_valid stays high while the packer is full, so a consumer counting valid&&ready sees duplicates. 402 A16 handshakes for 256 beats (146 duplicates) at BP2.
param_wr_* is completely inert: writing scale 0.5 through the parameter port while cfg_scale=1.0 produces the cfg_scale result (113/256 A16 beats differ from the parameter-port expectation).
cfg_ready=!in_burst allows a new descriptor to be loaded while the last accepted beat is still in the 9-stage lane. Beat accepted under scale 1.0 is output as 6 (new scale 3.0) instead of 2.

nonblocking_findings.summary: Old gemini_approx TIER=0 is broken by a factor of 2 (seed shifted by 8 instead of 7); mean DIV relative error 73.3%. TIER=2 is bit-identical to TIER=1 and all tiers have 4-cycle latency, confirming the old three-tier claim was fictitious.
New approx core correctly prunes TIER 0/2 and rejects TIER!=1, LATENCY!=5, II!=1 at elaboration. Latency=5, II=1, flush works. This structural repair is accepted.

The new approx source declares `input wire flush` with no default, while INTERFACE.md claims a default of 0. The existing ds_vector candidate instantiates it without .flush(); the port is unconnected, so the engine's synchronous core_flush does not drain the approx pipeline.
The repaired FMA's 1001-vector official fixture does not cover exact tie-to-even or extreme exponent alignment; it passes while our 90 normal-input adversarial vectors fail.

passed_items: i48->f32: 37,166 vectors, 0 mismatches, tags/last/stability OK; C cast cross-check 0 mismatches.
f32->i16: 464,154 vectors, 0 mismatches (RNE, ties, clamp, NaN/Inf), C lrintf cross-check 0 mismatches.
Epilogue leaf flush: i48/fma/f32i16/lane 0 errors; new FMA/lane latency-adjusted flush 0 errors.
Old/new epilogue mode 0 bypass, ReLU, spill data, 128-bit packing/zero padding: 0 data mismatches at BP0.
Stream abort: 0 post-abort outputs, statistics retained.
New approx: TIER/LATENCY/II rejection, flush, tag/order/stability, latency=5, II=1.
unverified: No exhaustive proof of i48->f32 or f32->i16; only 37k/464k adversarial vectors plus C cross-check.
No synthesis/Vivado/STA; no 300/600 MHz claim is made or accepted.
No full ASR model accuracy/WER/CER; the actual model's LayerNorm variance/epsilon range cannot be verified because no ONNX/calibration data is present in the read-only tree.

FMA/special signed-zero and subnormal-input semantics may differ from the vendor IP contract; our reference uses FTZ, so subnormal-input mismatches are reported separately and are not used as the primary FMA blocking evidence.
The epilogue stream engine's packed A16 path was tested with a BFM, not with the real ds_vector/ds_layout consumer.
The new approx core was not re-tested inside the ds_vector wrapper with its unconnected flush port.
